label: Bible Study
prompt: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. _____ is of the LORD.
verse: But I will sacrifice unto thee with the voice of thanksgiving; I will pay that that I have vowed. Salvation is of the LORD.
note: Jonah's prayer from inside the fish ends here — and the very next verse, he's back on dry land.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they _____.
verse: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him: and they wept.
note: After twenty years of dreading Esau's revenge, Jacob gets a running hug instead — and both brothers weep.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves _____.
verse: And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.
note: Fig-leaf aprons were Eden's first fashion line; the 1560 Geneva Bible said 'breeches,' earning it the nickname the Breeches Bible.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be _____, and do exploits.
verse: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do exploits.
note: Amid prophecies of a flattering tyrant, a promise: people who know their God will stand firm and act.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For the love of Christ _____ us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
verse: For the love of Christ constraineth us; because we thus judge, that if one died for all, then were all dead:
note: 'The love of Christ constraineth us' — hems us in and drives us on. Paul's motive for everything.
